mapper.sql: a.id, a.street_area_id, sa.name AS street_area_name, a.title, a.summary, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, a.activity_type, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status
FROM activity a LEFT JOIN street_area sa ON a.street_area_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON a.cover_file_id = sf.id
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.street_area_id, sa.name AS street_area_name, a.title, a.summary, a.description, a.cover_file_id, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, a.activity_type, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.location, a.poi_id, p.name AS poi_name, p.poi_type AS poi_type, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM activity a LEFT JOIN street_area sa ON a.street_area_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON a.cover_file_id = sf.id LEFT JOIN poi p ON a.poi_id = p.id WHERE a.id=#{id}
